### Four Marks of a Spiritual Leader
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/four-marks-of-a-spiritual-leader
Passage: Nehemiah 1:5-6
Points:
- Leaders must clearly recognize and acknowledge existing needs rather than ignoring reality.
- A godly leader personally identifies with and feels the distress of others.
- Bringing the situation to God in prayer must always be the first priority.
- Genuine spiritual leadership means making oneself personally available to help meet the need.

### When Life Seems Broken
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-august-23-2016.html
Passage: Nehemiah 1:3
Points:
- Christians do not have to hide their pain and can honestly mourn before God.
- Deep heartbreak should direct us immediately into earnest prayer and fasting.
- Biblical prayer combines sincere confession, intercession, and remembering God's promises.
- Trusting the Lord enables believers to move past fear and take courageous steps forward.
